queryValidation.scope: Only the manually adjudicated selections; all other document content remains outside this gold.

interpretation: Independent IP/TP/It heads no longer share another declaration body; TQ remains explicit shared ownership, not alias equivalence.
Complete declaration recovery adds PP/RS commands, keys and variable heads; typed local/native evidence overrides inherited context without a tool-name whitelist.
Source-visible TP bullets and prose-like hanging labels cease being entries; their visible text remains in ordinary content.
Parameter alternations and opaque templates retain complete forms but do not create argument-fragment names.
IDs and parent paths change with corrected ownership/names. Source-coordinate pairing is a delta summary, not independent proof of equivalent owners.
Selected query source/head/body/name/kind assertions are independently fixed in ENTRY_QUERY_GOLD.json; native AST coordinate candidates still require reviewer interpretation.
No aliasGroups, aliasOf or value-domain relationship change is inferred from adjacent heads or shared forms.
Snapshot query replay uses the final collector on the saved baseline IR, not the historical CLI binary. Full baseline IR and before performance were captured before modification.

performance.method: Same host/debug gcc --manual routes; stdout discarded; five sequential runs, median wall time and maximum RSS KiB. Warm-machine measurements, not controlled cold-cache benchmarks.

limits: Not a rerun of the historical 45036-page corpus.
Native macOS and Windows execution not available in this Linux run.
Formatter review/hard results remain visible; known reference deviations and bounded-recursion reference failure are not relabeled clean.
Reviewed conservative classifications and malformed source exceptions are query-specific notes in the manifest, not blanket acceptance of false owners.
Private upstream pager doctests reference the external minus API and are ignored; public ManT rustdoc, native pager unit tests and Unix PTY behavior are exercised.
